name: Amanda Ballard

items.why: At the July 2026 forum, Smith's Mosaic charge was a general opponent attack with no specific conduct or finding behind it, and her "50 cases" reply answered a separate jab about her legal experience, so it isn't a controversy under the work-record or abuse-of-office criteria (4, 6).
This item records no foreign-tie conduct, since the searched records show no FARA filings, foreign-government payments or foreign-agent donors (criterion 2).

for_review: 1) The Beacons article says Smith accused Ballard of siding with Mosaic but gives no specific vote or conduct. I found only opinion writing on this: a Bradenton Journal Substack guest column says Mosaic gave $350,000 to a shelter Ballard championed, and that she cast a deciding vote for Mosaic with the words 'I cannot find a reason to vote against them.' I could not open either Substack page or find the vote in official minutes, so please check the Manatee County Commission minutes for any Mosaic-related vote and the original reporting on the donation. 2) Separately, the same Substack sources describe her August/October 2023 vote to weaken wetland buffers. That is an ordinary vote, so it was not treated as a controversy here. 3) I did not read her campaign finance filings. She said her donors are local, including two affordable-housing developers. 4) The search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) found nothing about Ballard. 5) Her career as a child-welfare attorney is reported by independent outlets and is not in dispute. 6) Election result: she won on Nov. 3, 2026 by a very narrow margin.
